values.AssociatedLNGNotes: Enbridge says its Texas Eastern Transmission pipeline network supplies natural gas to four operating LNG facilities in the Gulf Coast. A U.S. Energy Information Administration article from December 2023 names one of them: the Venice Extension, a Texas Eastern project, can move up to 1.3 billion cubic feet per day to the Plaquemines LNG Terminal.

verifications.note: Enbridge company page: through its Texas Eastern Transmission pipeline network, it supplies natural gas to four operating LNG facilities in the Gulf Coast. Facilities not named on the page.

EIA article: Texas Eastern Transmission's Venice Extension Project can move up to 1.3 Bcf/d of natural gas to the Plaquemines LNG export terminal. Names the Texas Eastern system; the Venice Extension is a segment of it, not the mainline record itself.

records.researcher_notes: The Enbridge page describes the whole Texas Eastern network, so the tie is at network level and the tier is medium. Only Plaquemines is named in the sources found; the other three operating facilities are not named. Existing cells were blank.
